name: Flux Tube Filament Generation
aliases: Saturn Polar Magnetic Flux Tube Generation
definition: Algorithm to generate sample points along magnetic field lines (filaments) within a flux tube, incorporating radial convergence and stochastic noise.
summary: Flux Tube Filament Generation is a procedural algorithm that traces magnetic field lines using Euler integration with restoring forces and stochastic noise, differing from static grid sampling by explicitly simulating field line wandering.
